# Pomona

> Open-source, local-first edge AI platform for controlled-agriculture greenhouses. MQTT sensor ingest, SQLite persistence, compact specialist reasoners, deterministic safety checks, and a read-only dashboard. Early alpha (`v0.1.0-alpha.1`) — not a production automation product.

Pomona's hard rule: an LLM or reasoner model may advise, but a deterministic safety checker is always the final authority before any actuator or automation action. No model output ever directly controls hardware.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): quickstart (Docker Compose), architecture summary, project phase table
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): full architecture and data flow
- [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md): phase status and model roadmap

## Models and data (Hugging Face)
- [Pomona Collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Okyanus/pomona-local-ai-for-safer-greenhouse-decision-support-6a89931ffcc2f7a3f777f3b9): all published models and the dataset, in one place
- [Okyanus/pomona-tomato-risk-reasoner-v0.1.7-lora](https://huggingface.co/Okyanus/pomona-tomato-risk-reasoner-v0.1.7-lora): published tomato greenhouse risk-label reasoner
- [Okyanus/pomona-water-irrigation-risk-reasoner-v0.1.8-lora](https://huggingface.co/Okyanus/pomona-water-irrigation-risk-reasoner-v0.1.8-lora): irrigation/moisture risk reasoner, release candidate
- [Okyanus/ai-pomona-agronomist-gemma4](https://huggingface.co/Okyanus/ai-pomona-agronomist-gemma4): advisor LLM adapter
- [Okyanus/greenhouse-sensor-data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Okyanus/greenhouse-sensor-data): published greenhouse sensor dataset
- [docs/TOMATO_RISK_REASONER.md](docs/TOMATO_RISK_REASONER.md): model card with a real, reproducible input/output example

## Try it
- [Pomona Greenhouse Demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Okyanus/pomona-greenhouse-demo): live in-browser demo of the guarded tomato reasoner, no install, no login
- [examples/tomato_risk_quickstart.py](examples/tomato_risk_quickstart.py): standalone script, no extra dependencies, runs against a local `docker compose` stack
- [examples/scenarios/](examples/scenarios/): real greenhouse sensor JSON scenarios (routine, high-risk, missing/stale data)
